shellCommands.command: (npx next dev -p 3123 > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 12 && curl -sI http://localhost:3123/ | grep -i x-request-id; echo "---"; grep -iE "middleware|proxy|pathname|/" /tmp/next-dev.log | head -20
pkill -f "next dev" ; mv /workspace/middleware.ts /workspace/proxy.ts && sed -i 's/export function middleware/export function proxy/' /workspace/proxy.ts && cat /workspace/proxy.ts
mv /workspace/middleware.ts /workspace/proxy.ts && sed -i 's/export function middleware/export function proxy/' /workspace/proxy.ts && pkill -f "[n]ext dev" ; sleep 1; echo done
